title: DVGA
description: Damn Vulnerable GraphQL Application: a deliberately weak Flask and Graphene GraphQL API (a paste service) for learning GraphQL attacks, from introspection and batching denial of service to injection, SSRF and authorization bypass, in a beginner and an expert mode.
question: Solve the DVGA challenges listed for this lab: from introspection and denial of service to injection, authorization bypass and token forgery, ending with OS command injection to read /ctf/flag.
